development_note: Initial short run aborted due to incorrectly freeing gtools_getline static storage; removed free before every successful run. That abort is recorded for transparency and has no evidentiary use. Initial compiler diagnostics also caught nauty bit symbol collision, fixed before runs.
interpretation: Useful necessary filter: removes 61.94% of catalogue B graphs in the K1 degree-18 branch; 134112 B graphs still admit at least one qualifying row.
Not a proof that surviving B graphs extend to 43 vertices. Does not test A=K1 union C or compatibility of all other rows/columns. Does not exclude B graphs from the connected, K2 or K3 branches.
One witness per surviving B only; no enumeration/count of all row placements or automorphism orbits.
No new mathematical claim accepted, no Lean proof edits, no solver run, no downloads or installations.
kind: User-authorized catalogue experiment, not a certified Ramsey result

method.input_validation: Every input four-subset checked for I4; K4 masks enumerated. Prior hash-matched experiment checked K5-freeness. This run does not independently repeat every input five-subset.
method.io: nauty/gtools opengraphfile, gtools_getline, stringtograph; no built-in gtools command performs this existential row search, so a small C search is linked against local nauty.a.
method.search: Exact finite keep/drop partition. Require 17 kept, 7 dropped. Every kept vertex must have exactly 8 kept neighbors; propagate lower/upper degree bounds and cardinality. Every B K4 must meet dropped set. Branch on an uncovered K4, deleting one vertex and keeping earlier alternatives: disjoint exhaustive branches. If no uncovered K4 remains, binary branch on an undecided vertex. Stop after first witness per graph.
method.witness_format: One-based original input index and hexadecimal 24-bit selected-vertex mask, bit v for original zero-based vertex v. Survivor records preserve original input order and labels.

predicate: There exists R subset V(B), |R|=17, B[R] is 8-regular and K4/I4-free. Induced subgraphs, not arbitrary edge subgraphs. This is the full row conclusion of Ramsey.d18.k1.rigidity, not just regularity.

reproduction.binary_location: Compiled initially to /tmp/ramsey-filter-k1 and moved unchanged to data/r45_24/k1_filter after recorded runs.

verification.all_row_gtools: countg computes clique and independence numbers on all 134112 row graphs; exact line: 17 68 8 8 3 3 134112 (n,e,min_degree,max_degree,clique_number,independence_number,count).
verification.all_witnesses: Independent Python set-based graph6 decoder checks survivor bytes, mask size/range, and every selected vertex degree; re-encodes every induced row.
verification.fixture_definition: Positive: Paley17 (quadratic residues mod17) joined to a 7-clique; negative: K24. Only the first survives, witness 01ffff. Synthetic fixtures test the filter API, not B24 Ramsey-freeness.
verification.sample_method: All C(24,7)=346104 omitted sets for each of 40 deterministic samples, with independent regularity and exhaustive four-subset checks on degree-valid rows. All agree. Not an independent exhaustive replay of every rejection.
